crash.messageConfig: The settings file could not be read. Fix it or delete it, then start {app} again.
crash.messageCrash: {app} stopped unexpectedly. You can share the report with support, then restart the app.
crash.messageHang: The app may still finish. Wait, or close it to view the diagnostic report.
crash.messageHangStopped: {app} was closed after it stopped responding. You can share the report with support or restart the app.
crash.messageKilled: {app} closed before it could report the cause. You can share the available details with support or restart the app.
crash.messageOom: The system ran out of memory and closed {app}. You can share the report with support or restart the app.
crash.messageStartup: Fix the cause below, then start {app} again.
